summary: Verdict FAIL: 6 blocking, 17 advisory across the five-page package; most cross-page facts (Parachute Jump 1964, Cyclone, Sandy 600,000/580,000, enterococci 227 vs 104, season dates, boardwalk dates and costs, wheelchair access, casino vote) agree.

Worst finding: Luna Park's closing is told two ways on the main page: 'sources differ' with only one source in the explainer, and a flat 1946 in the timeline. The sheet's conflict note says to use 1944 or 1946.

Travel spoke miscounts the drownings ('two deaths' for three people) and states the $3 fare as fact when its sources only said it was expected; it also credits the $35 cap to ABC7, which reported $36.

Main reckoning credits the Sandy boardwalk surge to the Army Corps; the source is Marine Technology Reporter, and both spokes say so. It also stretches the activist's 'not the ocean as much' to 'not the ocean'.

The other fixes are a comma splice in day_in_time.dawn, 'late 1900s' (reads as the 20th century), an undated Deno's season range not in the sheet, plus meta-talk, slogan lines and jargon. Every fix has exact replacement wording.
